basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1703. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1703 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A young woman in a white headscarf and dark jacket sits on a red chair at a table, one hand resting on a large open book; an inkstand with a quill and a candlestick stand beside it against a dark panelled wall.
alt.zh: 一位戴白头巾、穿深色上衣的年轻女子坐在红椅子上，一只手搭在桌上一本摊开的大书上；旁边立着插着羽毛笔的墨水台和一只烛台，背后是深色的镶板墙。

note.en: Eglon van der Neer was the son of Aert van der Neer, whose moonlit river also hangs on this wall, and he chose the opposite subject: polished interiors and quiet figures. The reader has looked up from her book, as if someone had just come in. It is a small painting about being interrupted kindly.
note.zh: 埃格隆·范德内尔是阿尔特·范德内尔之子——父亲那幅月下河景也挂在这面墙上——他却选了相反的题材：精致的室内和安静的人物。读书的女子从书上抬起头，像是刚有人进来。这是一幅关于被温和打断的小画。
